info.name: Khatma BE - Zikr
info.description: Zikr Khatma creation, progress, member claims, and owner settings. Use the access token from the Auth collection. Protected routes return 401 without a valid bearer token; invalid bodies return 400; non-members receive 403 and unknown ids 404.

item.name: Create Zikr Khatma
item.description: Atomically creates an active Zikr Khatma and makes the current user its owner. Body: { name, phrase, goalCount }. Returns { id, name }.

item.name: Read Zikr progress
item.description: Members only. Returns { phrase, goalCount, completedCount, pendingCount, myPendingCount }.

item.name: Set or edit my pending amount
item.description: Sets this member's pending amount. Concurrent claims cannot exceed the remaining goal; unavailable capacity returns 409. Body: { amount }.

item.name: Release my pending amount
item.description: Removes the current member's pending amount. No pending claim returns 409.

item.name: Complete my pending amount
item.description: Moves the current member's pending amount to completed total and completes the Khatma once completedCount reaches goalCount. No pending claim returns 409.

item.name: Update Zikr settings
item.description: Owner only, active Khatmas only. Body: { phrase, goalCount }. Phrase can be corrected and goal increased; decreasing the goal returns 409.
